cases.title: Vector call discovery in the village
steps: Before this case, load the first occupied hunter from the supplied save copy and wait for the village.
Use that same hunter slot and the same input device in both roles.
This case discovers vector calls. Missing calls are not a player error; do not repeat the route to force coverage.
Begin this case in Test session. Stay still for three seconds and inspect the hunter, equipment and Chinese text.
Hold W or left stick up for two seconds, then release for two.
Hold D or left stick right for one second, release, then wait three seconds. Stop early at a wall or door; do not retry or enter it.
Hold J or right stick left for one second, then release. Observe the camera.
Open Test session and record Vector observation complete. Reopen it to mark your outcome, then close the game normally.
